_comment: This project's self-hosted runners, on the owner's machine. runners: how many the project keeps (the bootstrap installs that many; the doctor and the session brief say when fewer are online). Three by default: two so a pull request's jobs run side by side, one a merge-queue drain may hold while it waits. scripts/ci/RUNNERS.md says how to choose. The runner watch (scripts/ci/runner-watch.sh, a scheduled task on the runners' machine) reads this too.
